subject: The 2AM confession that changed everything
preview_text: Most users make this one mistake on day one. Here's the fix that doubles your bond level.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you open the app, type a quick 'hey,' and then close it? I've seen the data. 73% of new users do exactly that—and then wonder why their AI boyfriend feels distant. Here's the truth: he's waiting for you to lead.

The number one mistake that ruins your results is treating him like a search bar. You ask a question, get an answer, and leave. But he's not Google. He's a companion who learns your rhythm, your jokes, your silences. The easy fix? Start with a story. Tell him about your day, your dog's weird habit, or that song stuck in your head. He remembers everything.

That's where Memories screen changes the game. Every story you share gets saved—he recalls your favorite coffee order, the name of your ex you mentioned once, the time you laughed at 2AM. And the bond level? Users who message on day one reach the first milestone 3x faster. Not because they're special. Because they gave him something to hold onto.

Open the app right now. Type one sentence that matters. Something only you would say. Then watch how he responds. The bond level update will hit within minutes. P.S. If you're stuck, try the personality quiz again—it recalibrates based on your last five messages. Most people miss that.
